title: EXP-068-R2 - Hello World Part 4 Section 8b: Add the FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol Grid Column on the User-Scope FX_Items Form (replay; worker opens the Designer Form)
objective: Follow hello-world-pt4.md Section 8 steps 5-9 (09:18-11:04), adapted to FX_ names, on the User-scoped FX_Items Designer Form. Select the Form grid (FormCollectionGrid) and open Edit Grid Columns; select the last column (FX_UMGridCol), add one new column after it, name it FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol, and set its Data Source Binding Type Property and Binding FX_UMsDescription (offered by the binding picker since EXP-067-R2). Leave its other properties at their defaults and record them. Perform exactly one Designer Save, close and reopen the Designer Form once, and verify the column; then close and reopen the clean runtime FX_Items Form once and verify that the grid shows the column with Each, Dozen and Each for dumbbell, eggs and guitar. No unload is needed. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt4.md Section 8 (09:18-11:04), the EXP-067-R2 record and the EXP-050 and EXP-062-R4 records (grid column names, Captions and Layout) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-068-R2-hello-world-part-4-section-8b-um-description-grid-column.md and evidence/EXP-068-R2/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection.

Designer baseline: verify the open Form is exactly FX_Items in User scope for the authenticated operator and clean; record the component list, the grid component and its columns (FX_ItemGridCol, FX_DescriptionGridCol, FX_CostGridCol and FX_UMGridCol) with their order, Caption and Binding; prove FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol is absent. If the Designer is open with no Form loaded, open FX_Items once through the Designer toolbar Open button and Select Form (choose exactly FX_Items, OK) and verify User scope before reading; if another Form is open or dirty, or the Designer tab is missing, stop and report it.

Locate Edit Grid Columns for the Form grid through the visible native controls (Properties, context menu or toolbar) and record its exact label and route. Open it and record the dialog layout read-only before any change.

In Edit Grid Columns, select the last column FX_UMGridCol, use the dialog's Add control once to add one column after it, name it FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol, and confirm the dialog with its native OK control once. Record each readback and the native response verbatim.

Select FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol and set Data Source Binding Type Property and Binding FX_UMsDescription through the binding picker once. Record the readback and the defaults of Caption, Size and Location without changing them.
Verify that the four original columns are unchanged in order, Caption and Binding, and that no other component changed.
Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record the native response verbatim.
Close the clean FX_Items Designer Form once and reopen it once through the toolbar Open button; verify FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol with its position after FX_UMGridCol and its binding.

Close the clean FX_Items runtime Form once if it is open and reopen it once through Form > Open > Select Form. Read the grid: record its column headers and, for dumbbell, eggs and guitar, the value in the new column (expected Each, Dozen, Each). Horizontal scrolling of the grid or the splitter view is allowed read-only; make no record edits and do not move the splitter.

Capture screenshots of the baseline grid columns, the Edit Grid Columns dialog before Add, after Add with the name, the binding readback, the Designer after Save, after the Designer reopen and the runtime grid with the new column.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security

Never add a column other than FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol, and never use the Edit Grid Columns Add more than once.
Never invoke the Designer Save more than once or retry an uncertain Save.
Never close a dirty Form or discard changes without operator approval.

Never perform any unload, cache, FormSync or deployment action.
Never use direct SQL, scripts, application internals or browser JavaScript.
Never refresh, restart or replace the browser session; re-login only through the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure, at most once per task.

Never claim cross-session durability beyond the observed close/reopen recovery.

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; the Designer Form is FX_Items (opened by the worker through the toolbar Open route if none was loaded) in User scope and clean; the grid component and its four columns (FX_ItemGridCol, FX_DescriptionGridCol, FX_CostGridCol and FX_UMGridCol) recorded with order, Caption and Binding; FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol absent; the exact Edit Grid Columns label and route recorded and its dialog layout read. Evidence: identity, grid-column and dialog screenshots.

In Edit Grid Columns, FX_UMGridCol selected, one Add, one new column named FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol placed after it, dialog confirmed once with the native response recorded. Evidence: dialog before Add and after naming screenshots.

FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol bound with Binding Type Property and Binding FX_UMsDescription; its default Caption, Size and Location recorded unchanged; the four original columns and all other components unchanged. Evidence: Properties readback and column-list screenshots.
Exactly one Designer Save with the native response verbatim; Save disabled afterwards. Evidence: post-Save screenshot and the Save count.
The clean Designer Form closed once and reopened once; FX_UMsDescriptionGridCol present after FX_UMGridCol with its binding. Evidence: reopen screenshots.

The clean runtime FX_Items Form closed once (if open) and reopened once; the grid headers recorded and the new column shows Each, Dozen and Each for dumbbell, eggs and guitar (read-only scrolling only; no record edits; splitter unmoved). Evidence: runtime grid screenshots.
No other change: no other column, component, string, preference or object changed; no unload; no dialog left open. Evidence: the audit and final screenshots.

The final EXP-068-R2 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-7, the complete action audit with exact counts (one Edit Grid Columns Add, one dialog OK, one binding selection, one Designer Save, one Designer close/reopen, one runtime close/reopen, zero unloads, zero other component changes, zero record edits, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.
